The bottleneck is the ruling that releases work already sitting done, and every one of 24's four remaining calls is measured from the launch month.

blocks.name: The SOI card
blocks.plain: The words that run this operation. Say one and the protocol fires. Every term on this page is a live link; hover it, hold, and the definition opens. The full book is the SOI: the BREVITY.

strand.last: Ruled 9/11: DOPE SHEET (the status page) · SOI is the book · "the house tongue" and "glossary" retired · dark is the only theme.
strand.plan: The SOI page replaces the in-page glossary once it publishes (Charlie Mike pages, step 4). BOLO 37 moves rulings into a daily loop.
strand.you: You clarified FRAGO on your own read of doctrine: the update, never the page.
strand.next: Confirm OPORD as the page's word. Name the loop; MINT is the recommendation.
